summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder cancelled their FluxFit Online subscription on 18 March 2025 but was still billed 29.99 GBP on 20 April 2025, and asks for the charge to be reversed as a cancelled recurring transaction.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show the recurring terms and cancellation method, proof the cardholder opted in, proof of advance notice of this renewal, and that no cancellation was received before 20 April 2025.

requirements.title: Recurring terms disclosed
requirements.text: Terms of service disclosing the recurring billing arrangement and the cancellation method.
requirements.finding: The published membership terms disclose monthly auto renewal at the rate shown at signup and give two cancellation routes, the account dashboard or an email to support.

citations.quote: Subscriptions auto-renew monthly at the rate disclosed at signup until cancelled. Members may cancel at any time via their account dashboard or by emailing support@fluxfit.example.

requirements.title: Pre-charge notification sent
requirements.text: Evidence the cardholder was notified of the upcoming charge (typically 7 days in advance) for transactions over a defined threshold.
requirements.finding: The terms only promise that members will be notified by email before each renewal, which is a policy statement and not proof that a notice for the 20 April 2025 charge was sent to this cardholder.
requirements.gap: No copy of the renewal reminder email, send timestamp, recipient address or delivery log for the April 2025 billing cycle.

requirements.title: No cancellation before billing
requirements.text: No record of the cardholder having submitted a cancellation request prior to the billing date.
requirements.finding: Nothing in the file addresses the cardholder's stated cancellation on 18 March 2025; there is no account status history, support inbox record or cancellation queue export covering the period before 20 April 2025.
requirements.gap: No subscription status log or support ticket search showing the absence of a cancellation request between 1 March and 20 April 2025.

requirements.title: Original opt-in
requirements.text: Evidence of the cardholder's original opt-in to the recurring arrangement.
requirements.finding: Only a generic published terms document was supplied; it states on its face that it applies to all members and contains no signup record tying this cardholder to the recurring arrangement.
requirements.gap: No signup record, acceptance timestamp, IP or account identifier showing this cardholder agreed to recurring billing.

alerts.text: The cardholder states they cancelled on 18 March 2025 and the merchant has filed nothing that addresses the account status between that date and the 20 April 2025 charge.
The terms promise renewal notice at least 5 days in advance, short of the 7 day advance notice the reason code contemplates, and no notice for this renewal has been evidenced.

reasons: Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

justification: Three of the four requirements have no supporting record, but account and email logs the merchant should hold could close them.
rationale:
The issuer alleges the 29.99 GBP charge of 20 April 2025 (txn_8856OP) followed a cancellation made on 18 March 2025.
The only evidence filed is the generic terms_v3.2 document, which discloses monthly auto renewal and the dashboard or email cancellation routes and so meets the disclosure requirement.
That document is expressly the standard published terms applying to all members, so it does not evidence this cardholder's opt-in.
No renewal notice for the April cycle and no account or support record rebutting the claimed 18 March cancellation have been supplied.
Hold the representment until the merchant produces the signup, notification and cancellation records; without them the case cannot be defended.
merchant_requests: Signup record for this cardholder's FluxFit account showing the date, accepted terms version and acceptance timestamp for the recurring billing authorisation
Copy of the pre renewal email sent for the 20 April 2025 charge with recipient address and send or delivery timestamp from the email service provider
Subscription status history for the account from 1 March 2025 to 20 April 2025 showing it was active on the billing date
Export of support@fluxfit.example inbox and dashboard cancellation logs for 15 March to 20 April 2025 showing no cancellation request from this cardholder
Billing history for the account showing prior successful monthly charges of 29.99 GBP to confirm the established recurring arrangement
